# Avocado Digital

> Avocado Digital (Avocado Pty Ltd) is a small Australian software and strategy studio, established 2021 in Melbourne, building durable tools for small and medium businesses — bespoke software, curated technology, strategy consulting and LEX Waypoint (leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of LEX Phone), plus four products of its own: LEX Phone, Call Concierge, SocialReels and Claudette.

Key facts:

- Services: Workflow Solutions (bespoke software and workflow automation), Curated Technology (pragmatic tool selection and integration), Strategy Consulting (strategy intensives, roadmap shaping, pre-mortems, fractional CTO), LEX Waypoint (leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of LEX Phone).
- Legal entity: Avocado Pty Ltd, ACN 652 199 687, ABN 81 652 199 687.
- Contact: hello@avocadodigital.com.au · Reception +61 3 6358 8887

## Products

- [LEX Phone](https://ezybizlex.com.au/): the ultimate business phone for legal professionals — a dedicated business number with an Australian AI answering service (call screening, message taking, appointment booking) and every call filed to the right matter in Smokeball or Clio. Legal pages: https://ezybizlex.com.au/terms/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/privacy/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/acceptable-use/, https://ezybizlex.com.au/data-residency/.
- [Call Concierge](https://callconcierge.com.au): live Australian new-client intake for law firms, connected to EzyBiz.
- [SocialReels](https://socialreels.ai): short-form video for small business (private beta).
- [Claudette](https://github.com/Avocado-Pty-Ltd/Claudette): an open-source, voice-based IDE that turns speech into a working codebase (MIT licence, on GitHub).

## Services

- [Workflow Solutions](https://avocadodigital.com.au/workflow-solutions.html): bespoke software and workflow automation
- [Curated Technology](https://avocadodigital.com.au/curated-tech.html): tool selection and integration
- [Strategy Consulting](https://avocadodigital.com.au/strategy-consulting.html): strategy intensives, roadmaps, fractional CTO
- [LEX Waypoint](https://lexwaypoint.avocadodigital.com.au/): leads-to-matter analytics and intake improvement for Australian law firms, part of LEX Phone. It follows every call, text and web enquiry to the matter it became in Smokeball or Clio (calls and texts through LEX Phone; forms, inboxes and spend per channel imported), with results in LEX Phone Desktop. Everything is measured on leads to matter, the share of genuine enquiries (excluding spam and requests for work the firm doesn't do) that become opened matters, broken down by lead source (SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, referrals, directories such as LawConnect), contact method (calls, web forms, emails, messages) and response (response time, missed calls, drop-off before a matter opens). Three plans, each adding to the one before: Waypoint Insight (from $1,500 a month; works without LEX Phone; search and local ranking monitoring, a website audit, AI search optimisation and a monthly report, but no enquiry-to-matter tracking or return reporting), Waypoint Growth (from $3,000 a month; requires LEX Phone, with 4 free connections; LEX Phone calls and texts matched to matters in Smokeball or Clio, enquiry log import, leads-to-matter dashboard, response-time and missed-call analysis, intake fixes with Call Concierge or LEX Phone, missed-call text-back, callback targets, better contact forms, source tracking with tracking numbers and UTM/gclid capture, Google Business Profile posts with new reviews surfaced in LEX Phone to reply to, listings on LawConnect, LawTap and other law directories, social media, and website development including new SEO pages built from the audit and signed off by the firm's lawyers) and Waypoint Leadership (from $4,500 a month; requires LEX Phone, with 8 free connections; full SEO programme built around the firm's suburbs, including backlinks, multi-location support, cost-per-matter reporting by source). Existing phone numbers can be ported to LEX Phone; support for third-party VoIP providers is coming. Google and ChatGPT Ads management is a separate add-on available with any plan, reported on cost per matter. The Avocado team runs this marketing work (SEO, ads, Business Profile, directories and social), and a lawyer at the firm signs off anything before it goes live. It was previously called Law Firm Intake; it now has its own site at lexwaypoint.avocadodigital.com.au, and the old /lex-waypoint.html, /law-firm-intake.html and /legal-seo.html URLs redirect there.
